segments.narration: OMAR: Welcome to EHR Consultation Workflow: Guided Simulation. You will practise decisions that help you act with confidence. You will leave with practical actions for your next shift.
segments.on_screen_text: "EHR consultation workflow" · "Guided practice on a test patient"
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: Complete, specific, linked — on the day. Read the disclaimer.
segments.on_screen_text: Complete, linked, on the day · Disclaimer (B7) · "Everything here is a test patient."
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: The nine steps at a glance.
segments.on_screen_text: 9 steps as events: 1 Open · 2 Document · 3 Diagnose · 4 Order · 5 Review orders · 6 Summary · 7 Educate · 8 Refer & follow up · 9 Complete
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: Start from today's list. Work through the steps in order, then read the feedback.
segments.on_screen_text: Step 1: today's consultation list → click the test patient. Step 2: open the consultation form
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: The mandatory sections. Save as you go.
segments.on_screen_text: Consultation form screenshot; regions = each mandatory section (B4): chief complaint · duration · HPI · past history (allergies, medications) · examination · plan of care
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: Decide as you would on shift, then read the feedback.
segments.on_screen_text: "You press Complete and the system refuses. The form shows chief complaint, HPI and examination filled in." Most likely cause → plan of care (or another mandatory field per B4) is empty
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: Search by code or name. The primary diagnosis drives everything after it. My first week, I typed 'diabetes' and picked the first line. It wasn't the one I meant. Work through the steps in order, then read the feedback.
segments.on_screen_text: Step 1: click Add Diagnosis. Step 2: type E11 (accepted: E11, e11, type 2 diabetes). Step 3: choose Type 2 diabetes mellitus from results. Step 4: mark as primary / problem; onset, chronicity. Step 5: click the star to add …
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: Five ways to find an order. The Form Wizard checks a package before you commit.
segments.on_screen_text: Search by service · lab · referral · package · order profile · Form Wizard reviews a package before you finalise
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: Link every medication to the diagnosis you assessed. Work through the steps in order, then read the feedback.
segments.on_screen_text: Step 1: open order search. Step 2: type the drug name (B6 example). Step 3: set route, dose, frequency, duration. Step 4: choose the assessed diagnosis (E11). Step 5: add instructions to the patient. Step 6: press Order
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: Review the package. Remove what you don't need. Work through the steps in order, then read the feedback.
segments.on_screen_text: Step 1: search the package (B6). Step 2: Form Wizard step 1 — review items. Step 3: remove an item not needed. Step 4: finalise
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: Decide as you would on shift, then read the feedback.
segments.on_screen_text: "You order ⚠ PENDING non-formulary item, B6. The system flags it. What does that mean?" → it needs approval before it can be dispensed; consider a formulary alternative
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: Decide as you would on shift, then read the feedback.
segments.on_screen_text: "Why must each order be linked to the assessed diagnosis?" → it shows medical necessity to the reviewer and keeps the record consistent; unlinked orders are a common rejection cause
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: The summary is the record the patient takes home. Work through the steps in order, then read the feedback.
segments.on_screen_text: Step 1: open Consultation Summary. Step 2: check lab orders, special tests, referrals. Step 3: Download and Print
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: Education by SMS, matched to the diagnosis code. Work through the steps in order, then read the feedback.
segments.on_screen_text: Step 1: open Send SMS – educational material. Step 2: choose department. Step 3: type E11. Step 4: select the leaflet. Step 5: Send (B8)
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: NOOR: Patient & family education is required before you finish.
segments.on_screen_text: Checklist: infection control · medication use · disease/condition · treatment · health & lifestyle · other · "Required before finalising"
segments.speaker: noor

segments.narration: OMAR: Internal referral and follow-up. Work through the steps in order, then read the feedback.
segments.on_screen_text: Step 1: open referral. Step 2: specialty = Endocrinology. Step 3: type the reason (approved example phrase, e.g. "poorly controlled type 2 diabetes"; variants listed in input_accepted). Step 4: type = Internal; timing = within a month (B9). Step 5 …
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: Put the steps in the order you would follow at work, then read the feedback.
segments.on_screen_text: 9 steps from ehr-002 in order
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: Completing the encounter. Where to get help.
segments.on_screen_text: "Record saved successfully" → Complete · What happens if a field is missing · Where to get help (IT service desk)
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: Your results are organised by objective. Notice where you were confident, then revisit any section that needs another practical try.
segments.on_screen_text: ehr-o1…o5
segments.speaker: omar

segments.narration: OMAR: You can now use these key actions in your role. Keep the practical rule close, ask when you are unsure, and carry the next step into your shift. Take one clear next action with you.
segments.on_screen_text: Complete, specific, linked · Links: EHR quick-reference card (PDF), IT service desk
segments.speaker: omar
